b2-31-01.title: Communicative Challenge: A Closed Museum
b2-31-01.scenario: You are Meg. Carlos asks why you did not see the museum. The museum was closed when you arrived, and you could not go in.
b2-31-01.prompt: Tell Carlos what happened at the museum and what followed.
cues: Say what you could not do, with a formal result marker
b2-31-01.target: El museo estaba cerrado; por consiguiente, no pudimos entrar.
b2-31-01.english: The museum was closed; consequently, we could not go in.
b2-31-01.canDo: I can use *por lo tanto*, *por consiguiente* and *en consecuencia* to state a result.

b2-31-02.title: Communicative Challenge: A Crowded Party
b2-31-02.scenario: You are Carlos. Meg asks about the party you went to on Saturday. There were a lot of people, and you could not talk.
b2-31-02.prompt: Tell Meg how crowded the party was and what it led to.
b2-31-02.target: Había tanta gente que no pudimos hablar.
b2-31-02.english: There were so many people that we could not talk.
b2-31-02.canDo: I can say a result with *tan* … *que* and *tanto* … *que*.

b2-31-03.title: Communicative Challenge: A Quick Coffee
b2-31-03.scenario: You are Meg. Carlos says he is going to the bar to order another coffee. You would like a tea.
b2-31-03.prompt: Ask Carlos for a tea, giving his plan as the reason.
cues: Mention that he is going to the bar
b2-31-03.target: Ya que vas a la barra, pídeme un té.
b2-31-03.english: Since you are going to the bar, get me a tea.
b2-31-03.canDo: I can give a known reason with *ya que*, *puesto que* and *dado que*.

b2-31-04.title: Communicative Challenge: Traffic in the City
b2-31-04.scenario: You are Carlos. Meg asks why so many people cycle to work in Budapest. There is a lot of traffic in the centre.
b2-31-04.prompt: Explain to Meg why many people cycle.
cues: Say there is a lot of traffic
Say that is why many people cycle
b2-31-04.target: Hay mucho tráfico; de ahí que mucha gente vaya en bicicleta.
b2-31-04.english: There is a lot of traffic; hence a lot of people cycle.
b2-31-04.canDo: I can draw a conclusion with *así pues* and *entonces*.

b2-31-05.title: Communicative Challenge: A Missed Message
b2-31-05.scenario: You are Meg. Carlos asks why you did not answer his message. You did not have your phone.
b2-31-05.prompt: Explain to Carlos why you did not answer.
cues: Start with a marker that introduces an explanation
Say you did not have your phone
b2-31-05.target: Es que no tenía el teléfono.
b2-31-05.english: The thing is that I did not have my phone.
b2-31-05.canDo: I can justify myself with *es que*.

b2-31-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: Why Not Yesterday?
b2-31-consolidation.scenario: You are Carlos. Meg asks why you did not come yesterday. You had a lot of work, so you stayed at the office.
b2-31-consolidation.prompt: Tell Meg why you did not come and what you did instead.
cues: Say you had a lot of work
Say the result, with a connector
b2-31-consolidation.target: Tenía mucho trabajo, así que me quedé en la oficina.
b2-31-consolidation.english: I had a lot of work, so I stayed at the office.
b2-31-consolidation.canDo: I can read a short text about Clarice Lispector and her novel.
